project.name: Reshape not wrap: gRPC payment service behind the MCP facade (aggregator)
project.description: Chapter 15 ships two images: a separate gRPC payment-service and the MCP facade that reshapes JSON tool arguments into Protobuf and calls it. This aggregator builds and tests both modules with one `mvn verify`; each image is still built from its own Containerfile. The modules are independent (neither inherits from this pom); it aggregates them only so the example builds and verifies as a unit.
